t.text: Installed screen, Dark Modern, Modern UI look, 1:1 at the capture widths (sidebar 300 px, panel 932 px)

n1.text: 1 · nUIget 2.0 today. The 2.0 capture (VS Code 1.140.0, classic look, ExTester), cropped at 1:1: sidebar 300 × 813 without its title strip, panel 932 × 813. The five defects you named, measured in the research (section 8): V1 squeezed: the Installed/Updates tab strip is 25 px against 35 px workbench strips; buttons, inputs and selects are 24 px against 26. V2 misaligned: the bulk toolbar insets 16 px at the start and 6 px at the end (Uninstall selected ends at x 925, the list at 931); the selected row's band ends at x 907 and its actions sit outside it. V3 on the border: the section header's action slot sits on the list's right edge (x 931, width 0), and the sidebar's Update all ends at x 300, the pane edge. V4 header margins: DIRECT PACKAGES has 4 px above its box and 12 px below. V5 no scale: control gaps are {0, 4, 5, 8} with a 7 px stray padding on the tab bar. Also visible: 78 px rows with a line under each, uppercase section headers in both surfaces, a 32 px icon, a 14 px row check mark.

nA.text: A · Extensions view. Exemplar: the Extensions view for the rows, the Extensions editor for the tabs and the details inset. D-A row: the Extensions row: 72 px, 36 px icon after an 18 px check box at the 16 px inset, two lines (name 13/600; version · authors 11 px with the Verified mark), no line between rows, actions inside the row's band on hover and focus. D-B: 22 px compact rows in the sidebar. D-C: one grouped list in the panel: Direct and Transitive are 28 px group headers inside one listbox (one tab stop, arrows cross groups); the sidebar keeps the workbench's panes, Installed and Updates, each its own list. D-D: Enter opens: in the panel it shows the details, in the sidebar it opens the main panel on that row (the Extensions view's Enter); install, update and uninstall move to Ctrl/Cmd+Enter, Delete (confirmed) and the native context menu; row actions show on hover and focus. D-E: no toast for a single success; the row and the details change in place, the status bar and the live region announce; warnings and bulk summaries keep their toasts. Headers and tabs: 28 px Modern UI group headers (12 px/600, capitalised, hover tint, radius 4) with 19 px count badges at the end; Installed/Updates and Details/README as the Extensions editor navbar (36 px, 11 px uppercase labels, panelTitle colours, 1 px underline). Primary action: last in its row; the bulk toolbar is a 26 px button row with 16/16 insets and Uninstall Selected at the end; Update follows the version selector. Disabled buttons use the workbench's opacity 0.4 until D-G is decided; the row check box is the 18 px workbench check box (D-H option 1). The selection ring is keyboard focus; a pointer selection draws none under Modern UI. The side-bar title strip is VS Code's own (32 px, 12 px/600 capitalised under Modern UI, so the host renders NUIget: TestProject) with four title actions plus More Actions (the two toggles move there); the same strip is drawn in B and C. Trade-off: the most space per package (72 px rows plus a 42 px toolbar band, about 8 packages visible here), and the grouped list costs about 7 planned days.

nB.text: B · Settings editor. Exemplar: the Settings editor: scope tabs with text counts, setting items with a label column, 18 px check boxes with labels. D-A row: the Extensions anatomy kept (72 px, 36 px icon, two lines, no line between rows, actions inside the band on hover and focus). D-B: 22 px compact rows in the sidebar. D-C: one list per section, today's model and the workbench's panes: Direct and Transitive are separate listboxes under 28 px headers (two tab stops, no new list work, so the 7 planned days are saved). D-D: Enter only selects; opening the main panel moves to the context menu, and writes to Ctrl/Cmd+Enter, Delete (confirmed) and the menu. D-E: no toast for a single success; in-place state, status bar and live region. Header: the two options become Settings check boxes (18 px, radius 3) with their labels on their own line under the search box. Tabs: the list column's header line is the Settings scope-tab strip (33 px, 13 px label with a text count, 1 px underline in panelTitle colours, where Settings itself uses settings.headerForeground), with Select All and Uninstall Selected as icon actions at its end, so there is no separate toolbar band; Details/README use the same strip. Details: a property list (label column 7em, 26 px controls, 12 px above and 18 px below each block, section titles 13/600). Counts: text counts in the panel (Installed (2), Direct Packages (2), as the Settings table of contents), count badges in the sidebar. Primary action: at the end of the line it acts on. The sidebar is as in A, shown in its Modern UI state (the classic 22 px uppercase headers switch to 28 px capitalised). Trade-off: the bulk actions become icons that only tooltips name, and per-section lists keep two tab stops where the workbench's trees have one.

nC.text: C · Tree view. Exemplar: the Explorer and Source Control trees; the Extensions editor for the details. D-A row: neither card: one 22 px tree row per package with a 16 px icon, name, version and authors with the Verified mark on one line; inline actions on hover and focus, as Source Control's. D-B: 22 px everywhere, the panel included. D-C: one tree per view: group rows with twisties (Direct Packages and Transitive Packages in the panel; Installed and Updates in the sidebar, no split), one tab stop, arrows cross groups. No row check boxes: multi-selection is the tree's own (Ctrl/Shift+click, Ctrl/Cmd+A), so D-H falls away. D-D: Enter opens (the Explorer and Source Control); writes on Ctrl/Cmd+Enter, Delete (confirmed) and the native context menu. D-E: no toast for a single success; in-place state, status bar and live region. Group rows are tree rows: body size, normal case, count badge at the end. Tabs: the workbench panel's own tab style under Modern UI (32 px part title, 12 px labels without uppercase, count badges, a 1 px indicator under the label), for Installed/Updates and Details/README alike. The bulk actions are inline actions of the Direct packages group row, as Source Control's Stage All Changes (drawn visible; they show on hover and focus). Uninstall Selected acts on the tree's selection, so with Newtonsoft.Json selected it reads Uninstall Selected (1), as the Explorer's Delete acts on its selection. Details: the Extensions editor header (20 px inset, name 26 px/600, publisher line, description, action row) over the tab strip. Primary action: Update right after the version selector, first among the buttons as in the Extensions editor; bulk actions on the group row. Trade-off: the densest (about 30 rows visible here), but package icons shrink to 16 px, the authors truncate first at narrow widths, the bulk actions hide until hover or focus, and multi-selection loses its visible check marks.
